_comment: R18-A6 / AT-611 (T6) — offline app->repo mapping fixture. Keyed by org id (a 'default'/'*' key is the fallback for any org). Each entry declares which A2-ingested repos ARE an application, and on which platform. Non-secret configuration only — credentials never live here. The app_id/service is the SAME identity phase one uses for the running application, so the runtime->structure join (T4) has a key.
